jobs.title: Business Developer tipee FR (60%-100%)
jobs.description:
Business Developer tipee FR (60%-100%)
Join our tipee team!
Located in the heart of Lausanne, we are an SME with around fifty passionate collaborators. We develop tipee, a time management application and HR portal that has been simplifying the lives of our clients for over 10 years.
Operating in a participative and agile manner, our company is organised into circles where everyone is autonomous, has a say, and opportunities for growth within the company. All this with a positive impact for our clients, colleagues, the community, and the environment.
To develop our commercial activities, we are currently looking for a Business Developer tipee FR - DE (60%-100%) to meet demand and introduce tipee to our potential clients based in French-speaking Switzerland.
Your day at tipee:
• you handle leads obtained through our various marketing actions

• you organise online demonstrations (and sometimes on-site) for our potential clients

• you then prepare a personalised offer for them

• aware of the importance of follow-up, you occasionally contact them by email and phone to answer their questions

• you participate in our various events (HR fairs, client events, etc.)

• you contribute to reflections concerning our various commercial & marketing actions

You have...
• an excellent commercial instinct

• a reputation for being an open, lively person who enjoys contact

• good listening skills and a resourceful mind

• a good command of modern IT tools

• an interest in new technologies and digital marketing

• ideally some experience in the HR field

Working with us also means-
• being part of a friendly team

• an organisation that empowers everyone

• flexible working hours with the possibility of remote work

• a pleasant working environment

You will find more information on our page tipee.ch/carriere
We look forward to meeting you.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Join SALESIANER REGIO AG as a Business Development Manager! Enjoy a dynamic work environment with growth opportunities.

Tasks

• Drive sales of our laundry services in the field.

• Acquire new clients and manage existing customer relationships.

• Support cross-selling and collaborate with colleagues on customer meetings.

Skills

• Completed vocational training with relevant sales experience required.

• Fluent German and strong MS Office skills needed.

• Must demonstrate teamwork and professionalism.

Your mission with us:
• You work in field sales and are responsible for selling our laundry services.
• Acquiring new customers, developing and supporting existing customers, as well as systematically pursuing sales targets in your area are central responsibilities.
• Through active customer relationship management, you ensure high satisfaction.
• Expanding the product range, cross-selling to existing customers, and supporting colleagues from other business areas during customer appointments complete your range of tasks.
• If necessary, you also take on the deputy role in the Linen2GO shop , for example during holidays or absences of the shop colleague.
What convinces us:
• You have completed vocational training and have relevant experience in field sales.
• Fluent German in spoken and written form as well as good MS Office skills, especially in Word, Excel and Outlook, are required.
• You are characterised by a quick grasp, resilience and an independent as well as structured way of working.
• Team spirit and a friendly, professional appearance complete your profile.
What we offer you:
• At Linen2Go, you work in an environmentally oriented and innovative young company embedded in the stable structures of a long-established company.
• You will find a varied role in an internationally successful, owner-managed group of companies with headquarters in Vienna.
• You work in a motivated, professional and management-close department.
• You will receive comprehensive training and subsequently exciting development opportunities.
• Ongoing training and varied company events are among our benefits, as are the diverse discounts in the areas of travel, sport, gastronomy, etc.

jobs.title: CEO (m/f/d) – Bandleader Wanted
jobs.description:
A conductor stands in front of the orchestra and sets the tone with the baton. A bandleader stands right in the middle, plays along, counts in – and listens carefully to know when it’s time for others’ solos.
That’s exactly the person we are looking for: someone to lead our family-oriented marketing and fundraising agency into the next generation. With groove, with conviction, and with joy in the shared sound.
The Band
asm Fundraising AG has been playing for non-profit organisations, foundations, and public institutions for more than 40 years – on stages throughout Switzerland and in several languages. Our 20 musicians master a wide range of instruments: strategy, creation, data, and fundraising.
What holds us together is not a sheet of music, but a shared attitude. Reliability, respect, and the commitment to serve the cause are the fundamental tone on which everything is built. When planning the tour, the board of directors is on board: as sparring partners who listen, think along, and help shape the shared sound.
Your Role in the Band
• Keep the groove: You set the strategic direction, think ahead, and develop the agency’s repertoire together with the board of directors.
• Play along instead of conducting: You stand in the middle of the team, lead appreciatively and with strong implementation skills, and embody our values – out of conviction, not obligation.
• Enable solos: You recognise talents, nurture and coach them, delegate gladly, and blend individual voices into new sounds.
• Compile the setlist: You manage the client portfolio according to profitability and complexity, win new mandates, and recognise which pieces fit together.
• Keep in time: You have a firm grasp of numbers, key figures, and controlling, use contract models flexibly, and ensure structures that work even without you.
• Dare new pieces: You question the status quo, drive digitalisation forward, and create space for improvisation – without losing sight of the final chord.
• Stand on stage: You represent the agency credibly externally and remain calm when a string breaks.
What You Bring
Your Instrument Case
• Tertiary-level degree (FH or university), ideally with CAS or MBA
• Experience as a managing director or member of executive management
• Fundraising understanding and a network in the NPO and philanthropy sector
• Solid business management skills, negotiation skills, and project management experience
• Digital judgement that does not lose sight of people – with a fine ear for critical questions and feedback
• Understanding of the interplay within federalist Switzerland
• Fluent in German and French, very good in English; Italian is your bonus
Your Sense of Rhythm
• You feel at home in a family business and enjoy playing in an ensemble.
• You are honest, loyal, and reliable – the music is more important than your own applause.
• You listen before you play: with high emotional intelligence and sensitivity to constellations.
• You find the right tone for every audience – from the Federal Councillor to the cleaning staff.
• You make complex things sound simple and create clarity when it gets loud.
• You are curious, courageous, and seek advice when a part is new.
What We Offer You
• Your place on stage: the centre of a well-rehearsed, interdisciplinary band
• A repertoire with meaning: mandates for organisations that advance society and the environment
• Freedom for new arrangements: plenty of creative freedom and a careful handover – we play the first pieces together
• A rehearsal room with the best acoustics: central location in Zurich and modern office infrastructure
• Breaks between concerts: 5 or 6 weeks’ holiday so you return to the stage with fresh energy
• A sound that resonates – even after the last tour: attractive personal insurance, especially strong occupational pension plans, with contributions mostly covered by us
Fancy a jam session?
Then count in: Send us your complete application documents. We are also happy to offer an initial preliminary discussion. Discretion is, of course, guaranteed.

jobs.title: Managing Director 100%
jobs.description:
Join the team as a Geschäftsführer*in at Schifflände Maur! A chance to lead a vibrant restaurant by the scenic Greifensee.

Tasks

• Plan and organize all operations and activities.

• Oversee events like banquets and seminars.

• Enhance the à la carte dining experience.

Skills

• Experience in hospitality with a strong educational background.

• Excellent organizational and improvisational skills.

• Strong leadership and effective communication abilities.

Become part of a culinary success story!
As Managing Director 100% , you will be a valuable part of our 20-member Schifflände Maur crew from 1 November 2026 or by arrangement .
The popular excursion restaurant Schifflände Maur is beautifully located directly on Lake Greifen. With around 100 indoor seats, spread over the lake restaurant and country tavern, as well as over 140 terrace seats with self-service, culinary experiences are guaranteed. The heart of the kitchen is fish specialties, complemented by seasonal meat and vegetarian dishes. The hall offers space for celebrations with up to 140 guests - perfect for weddings, banquets and special occasions.
Managing Director 100%
Your day with us:
• Planning and organising all processes and activities
• Conducting banquets and seminars
• Promoting the à la carte business
• Motivated implementation of the operating concept, mission statement and leadership guidelines
• Personal guest care with charm and sensitivity
• Goal-oriented leadership of your team
• Ensuring high quality at all levels
• Maintaining various statistics as well as administrative tasks
How you fit with us:
• Solid training and professional experience in the hospitality industry
• Organisational and improvisational talent
• Quick comprehension and solution-oriented action
• Leadership experience as well as reliable and structured working style
• Polished manners and convincing communication
• Front-facing and committed personality
• Enjoyment of a lively operation
What you can look forward to:
The restaurant Schifflände Maur is a Remimag company. The creative family business has shaped the world of gastronomy and hospitality for over 40 years. Here, enjoyment meets passion and innovation. As a member of the Remimag family, we offer you unique benefits:
• 30% discount on consumptions in all Remimag establishments - for you and up to three companions
• Vitality bonus: Twice a year we reward health and commitment
• Remimag days: From the third year of employment, you receive seven additional loyalty days
• 100% accident supplementary insurance from the first day
• Shopping advantages: Benefit from exclusive prices on wine, crockery, decorations and more
• Management trip
Take the next step:
Grow with us and become part of our success story. Apply now and actively shape the future of gastronomy - we look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Betriebsleiter (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Führen und Entwickeln
Unser Auftraggeber ist ein international tätiges Industrieunternehmen, das innovative Lösungen entwickelt, produziert und installiert. Mit eigenen Produktionsstandorten und einem weltweiten Vertriebsnetz bedient es Kunden in verschiedenen Märkten. Qualität, technische Innovationskraft und die kontinuierliche Optimierung der Produktionsprozesse prägen den Unternehmenserfolg.
Ihre Herausforderung
Am Schweizer Standort übernehmen Sie die operative Gesamtverantwortung für mehrere Produktionsbereiche, den Einkauf sowie die Logistik. Gemeinsam mit rund 80 Mitarbeitenden stellen Sie effiziente, kostenbewusste und termingerechte Abläufe sicher. Sie entwickeln Prozesse und Strukturen kontinuierlich weiter und treiben die Produktivität sowie die bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit voran.
Das bringen Sie mit
Sie verfügen über eine technische Grundausbildung im industriellen Umfeld sowie eine Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF oder Meister in einem der Bereiche Technik oder Produktion. Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung in einem produzierenden Industrieunternehmen bildet die Basis. Sie verstehen die gesamte industrielle Wertschöpfungskette und streben Operational Excellence an. Sie kommunizieren verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.
Die Perspektiven
Das Unternehmen bietet Ihnen ein professionelles Industrieumfeld, in dem Sie Verantwortung übernehmen, Ihre Führungskompetenzen einbringen und operative Abläufe aktiv weiterentwickeln können. Es erwarten Sie kurze Entscheidungswege, ein vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet und die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team nachhaltige Verbesserungen zu erzielen und die Zukunft des Unternehmens mitzugestalten. Arbeitsregion: Bodensee – St. Gallen.
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Finance and Sales Controlling Employee 100%
jobs.description:
Swiss craftsmanship for the kitchen –
our passion knows no bounds.
For over 75 years, at Suter Inox AG, we have combined Swiss craftsmanship with innovative technology and a strong service orientation – for discerning customers who value uncompromising quality, predictability, and design freedom.
We are an owner-managed Swiss SME with around 150 employees and our own production facility based in Schinznach-Bad. Our core market is Switzerland, with showrooms in Zurich and Crissier. Since autumn 2025, we have also been represented with a company location and showroom in Germany. Suter products are also distributed throughout Europe via partners.
As a stainless steel specialist, our core competence lies in customised stainless steel worktops as well as sinks and basins with innovative drain and overflow technology. Taps from the Suter own brand and selected exclusive models from partner brands complement the range.
Finance and Sales Controlling Employee 100%
Your impact
As part of our controlling team, you are responsible for the following tasks:
• Preparing and processing sales forecasts and budgets
• Ensuring sales controlling
• Creating evaluations for sales and management
• Assisting in financial accounting (closing) and financial controlling
• Participating in projects
What excites us
• Completed business studies with a focus on controlling or finance or an equivalent qualification (professional certificate)
• Several years of professional experience in sales controlling is central for this position. Knowledge of financial accounting rounds off your profile
• Strong analytical skills, a structured way of working, and a very good understanding of financial contexts characterise you
• Excellent Excel skills are among your key strengths
• You work carefully, in a structured manner, and keep an overview even in hectic situations
• You are a motivated, reliable, and team-oriented personality who enjoys taking responsibility and acts solution-oriented
• Thanks to your quick grasp, you quickly familiarise yourself with new tasks and processes
• Experience in the construction ancillary industry is an advantage
What we offer you
A demanding and exciting role as part of a motivated team. High-quality products in a modern and future-oriented Swiss family business. You can expect comprehensive induction, contemporary social benefits, and various employee events.

jobs.title: Servicefachperson (w/m/d), 60 - 80 %
jobs.description:
Du bist gerne Gastgeber und sorgst dafür, dass sich Gäste willkommen fühlen? In unserem neuen Restaurant Limmat Rechts erwartet dich eine vielseitige Aufgabe zwischen Selbstbedienung und persönlichem Service. Du bringst Menschen zusammen, sorgst für genussvolle Momente und bist mit deiner offenen Art ein wichtiger Teil unseres Restaurantteams.
Das Regionale Pflegezentrum Baden gehört zu den grössten Anbietern von Langzeitpflege in der Schweiz. Wir bieten unseren Bewohnenden jeden Alters in verschiedenen Kompetenzbereichen spezialisierte professionelle Pflege und Betreuung. Unser Hauptsitz in Baden (AG) wird aktuell durch Neu- bzw. Umbauten umfassend modernisiert und mit 86 neuen Alterswohnungen ergänzt.
Mit dem neuen Restaurant Limmat Rechts schaffen wir einen lebendigen Treffpunkt für Bewohnende, Angehörige, Mitarbeitende und externe Gäste. Unser Angebot reicht von der unkomplizierten Selbstbedienung über Kaffee und Patisserie bis zum bedienten Restaurant mit persönlichem Service. Auch Seminare, Bankette und Veranstaltungen gehören zu unserem vielseitigen Gastronomieangebot.
Für den RPB-Standort in Baden suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit als
Servicefachperson (w/m/d), 60 - 80 %
Damit unterstützt du uns:
• Du empfängst und bedienst unsere Gäste freundlich, aufmerksam und zuvorkommend – im Selbstbedienungsbereich ebenso wie im bedienten Restaurant
• Du sorgst für einen reibungslosen Serviceablauf und eine angenehme Atmosphäre
• Du berätst unsere Gäste bei der Auswahl von Speisen und Getränken
• Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und Präsentation unseres kulinarischen Angebots
• Du betreust interne und externe Anlässe, Seminare und Bankette
• Du erstellst das Mise en Place und sorgst für Ordnung und Sauberkeit im Servicebereich
• Du bedienst die Kasse und stellst eine korrekte Tagesabrechnung sicher
• Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und Ausstattung unserer Seminarräume
Damit kannst du uns überzeugen:
• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Restaurationsfachperson EFZ, Restaurationsangestellte EBA, Fachperson Hauswirtschaft EFZ oder bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Service mit
• Du hast Freude am Gästekontakt und eine ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung
• Du arbeitest selbstständig, vorausschauend und zuverlässig
• Du bist teamfähig, flexibel und behältst auch in lebhaften Momenten den Überblick
• Du kannst dich mündlich und schriftlich gut auf Deutsch verständigen
• Du verfügst über gute IT-Anwenderkenntnisse und bist bereit, mit unserem Kassensystem zu arbeiten
• Du bist bereit, auch an Wochenenden Einsätze zu leisten
Damit begeistern wir dich:
• Ein neues Restaurant mit abwechslungsreichem Angebot und unterschiedlichen Servicebereichen
• Eine vielseitige Aufgabe mit Kontakt zu unterschiedlichen Gästen
• Ein engagiertes Team und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du dich einbringen kannst
• Planbare und regelmässige Arbeitszeiten
• Eine achtsame Du-Kultur geprägt von Respekt und Wertschätzung
• Ein internes, vielseitiges Weiterbildungsprogramm
Und das ist noch nicht alles! Entdecke auf unserer Karriereseite viele weitere attraktive Benefits in den Bereichen Work-Life-Balance, Gesundheitsförderung, Wellness, Vergünstigungen und Zukunft.
Bist du bereit?
Fachliche Auskünfte erhältst du von Raphael Kuster, Leitung Gastronomie, Telefon 056 203 81 33.
Fragen zum Bewerbungsablauf beantwortet dir Maurus Felix, Leitung Human Resources, Telefon 056 203 81 29.
